subject: Read-only corpus QA: Doudna listing page
body: Doudna harvest includes https://innovativegenomics.org/multimedia-library-category/jennifer-doudna as a dated (2023-04-19) research document. It is an archive/index page, 1,790 chars, in pre-T history and already has an exa.jsonl row; no check row yet. Exclude it before resuming check/pairs to avoid later titles entering history. Other undated doudnalab.org/people, /bio and Bluesky profile are excluded by dated_docs.
